request: Simplify rental setup, identify products by their catalogue photos, reuse saved details and add reviewed AI help.
implemented: Three steps: Product & price, Quantity, Confirm.
Catalogue photo cards with name/SKU, multiple views and original-photo link; missing or failed photos have a visible fallback.
Reuse an existing rental offer's saved price, deposit and revision; require explicit choice when more than one offer exists.
Main inputs are use-day rent, refundable security and actual quantity. Advance/fitting/fees/rack/condition/manual codes and bundled options are collapsed.
AI setup help uses existing photos and owner notes through the existing protected Smart Fill API. Only title and owner-evidenced rental terms can be applied after review.
Quantity registration generates unique codes and remains idempotent. Complete every component before continuing for bundled sets.
Keep the selected product visible on quantity and confirmation; activate through existing backend readiness checks, then open Orders → Rental bookings.
Scope product/offer metadata to the selected store; ignore stale workspace reads after a shop switch.
retainedSafeguards: Real physical inventory stays merchant-entered and separate from sale stock.
AI does not invent rent, deposit, actual stock or measurements.
Optional sizes remain optional; existing saved fitting and policy settings are reused.
Store membership, inventory/catalogue permissions, listing revision, transaction readiness, licence and activation checks remain enforced.
No original product images are overwritten.

verification.photoFixture: Bundled logo images, not actual bridal product originals.

deployment.notesFallback: Explicit rental terms in owner notes remain supported if photo AI is unconfigured.
